words.enDefinition: a letter introducing an applicant and explaining their suitability for a job

examples.en: I rewrote my cover letter after learning what the library assistant role involved.
examples.zh: 了解图书馆助理的职责后，我重写了「求职信」。

examples.en: The application asked me to upload one cover letter for each position I selected.
examples.zh: 申请系统要求我为选中的每个岗位分别上传一封「求职信」。

collocations: a cover letter for an internship

words.zhGloss: 随申请发送的介绍邮件
words.enDefinition: a short email introducing an applicant and the job application documents it carries
acceptedZhAnswers: 随申请发送的介绍邮件

examples.en: I used the cover email to explain which internship I was applying for.
examples.zh: 我在「随申请发送的介绍邮件」里说明了自己申请的是哪个实习岗位。

examples.en: My adviser suggested keeping the cover email brief because the documents were attached.
examples.zh: 顾问建议把「随申请发送的介绍邮件」写短一点，因为申请材料都在附件里。

words.enDefinition: a letter asking an organization about possible work opportunities when no vacancy is advertised

examples.en: I sent a letter of interest to the museum before it posted summer vacancies.
examples.zh: 博物馆发布暑期空缺前，我先给它寄了「求职意向信」。

examples.en: My letter of interest asked whether the studio ever hired students for short projects.
examples.zh: 我的「求职意向信」询问这家工作室会不会请学生参与短期项目。

collocations: a letter of interest to an employer

words.enDefinition: a letter explaining why a person wants a particular opportunity or program

examples.en: The placement asked for a letter of motivation about working with young learners.
examples.zh: 实习项目要求提供一封「申请动机信」，说明为什么想和低龄学生一起工作。

examples.en: In my letter of motivation, I described how the placement fit my studies.
examples.zh: 我在「申请动机信」里说明了这项实习怎样与我的学业相衔接。

words.enDefinition: a cover letter written to address a specific vacancy and its requirements

examples.en: My targeted cover letter refers to the two evening shifts mentioned in the posting.
examples.zh: 我这封「针对岗位写的求职信」提到了招聘启事里的两个晚班。

examples.en: The tutor showed how a targeted cover letter could connect coursework to this role.
examples.zh: 导师示范了怎样在一封「针对岗位写的求职信」里，把课程经历与这个岗位联系起来。

collocations: a targeted cover letter for each role

words.enDefinition: a cover letter written broadly enough to send for many different jobs

examples.en: The first draft read like a generic cover letter until I added specific examples.
examples.zh: 加上具体例子之前，初稿读起来像一封「通用求职信」。

examples.en: I saved my generic cover letter as a starting point for later applications.
examples.zh: 我保存了「通用求职信」，方便以后写申请时用作初稿。

collocations: start with a generic cover letter

words.enDefinition: a model that provides a reusable layout or structure for an application letter

examples.en: I opened a cover letter template and replaced the heading with my own details.
examples.zh: 我打开一个「求职信模板」，把开头的信息换成了自己的。

examples.en: The careers team shared a cover letter template for students applying by email.
examples.zh: 就业指导团队给通过邮件申请的学生分享了一个「求职信模板」。

words.enDefinition: a preliminary version of a job application letter that may be revised

examples.en: My tutor read the cover letter draft and asked for a clearer opening.
examples.zh: 导师看了「求职信草稿」，建议把开头写得更清楚。

examples.en: I reopened my cover letter draft to update the employer's name before sending it.
examples.zh: 我重新打开「求职信草稿」，在发送前更新了雇主的名称。

collocations: send your cover letter draft for feedback

words.enDefinition: the first sentence of a letter or other written text

examples.en: The opening sentence names the role and says where I saw the advertisement.
examples.zh: 「开头第一句」写了岗位名称，也交代了我从哪里看到招聘广告。

examples.en: I rewrote the opening sentence after my adviser noticed the job title was missing.
examples.zh: 顾问发现我没有写岗位名称后，我重写了「开头第一句」。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization a letter or other item is addressed to

examples.en: I checked the addressee against the name given on the application page.
examples.zh: 我对照申请页面上的姓名，核实了「收件人」。

examples.en: The addressee on my letter was the head of the recruitment team.
examples.zh: 我这封信的「收件人」是招聘团队的负责人。

collocations: address it to the correct addressee

words.enDefinition: a group that reviews candidates and helps choose who is hired

examples.en: I wrote my cover letter to the hiring committee because no name was listed.
examples.zh: 招聘启事没有给出个人姓名，所以我把求职信写给了「招聘评审委员会」。

examples.en: The application invited me to share three projects with the hiring committee.
examples.zh: 申请说明请我向「招聘评审委员会」展示三个项目。

collocations: address a letter to the hiring committee
a member of the hiring committee
send materials to the hiring committee

words.enDefinition: a greeting used in a job application addressed to an unnamed person who manages hiring

examples.en: I wrote “Dear Hiring Manager” because the posting did not name a contact person.
examples.zh: 招聘启事没列联系人的姓名，所以我写了「尊敬的招聘负责人」。

examples.en: The cover letter sample used “Dear Hiring Manager” above the first paragraph.
examples.zh: 求职信范本在第一段上方用了「尊敬的招聘负责人」。

collocations: use Dear Hiring Manager as the greeting

words.enDefinition: a formal opening for a letter when the specific reader's name is unknown

examples.en: The reference letter began with “To Whom It May Concern” before the first paragraph.
examples.zh: 推荐信的第一段前面用了「致相关负责人」作称呼。

examples.en: I asked whether “To Whom It May Concern” was too formal for this application.
examples.zh: 我问在这份申请里用「致相关负责人」会不会太正式。

collocations: begin with to whom it may concern
use to whom it may concern
address a letter with to whom it may concern

words.enDefinition: the word or phrase used to end a letter or email before the sender's name

examples.en: My cover letter used a formal sign-off followed by my full name.
examples.zh: 我在求职信里先写了正式的「信末落款语」，再写上全名。

examples.en: The adviser suggested changing the sign-off because it sounded too casual for the firm.
examples.zh: 顾问建议换一个「信末落款语」，因为原来的写法对这家公司来说有点随便。

words.enDefinition: a repeated block at the end of an email with a sender's name or details

examples.en: My email signature includes my name, course and a link to my portfolio.
examples.zh: 我的「邮件签名档」包含姓名、专业和作品集链接。

examples.en: I removed my old telephone number from the email signature before contacting the recruiter.
examples.zh: 联系招聘人员前，我从「邮件签名档」里删掉了旧电话号码。

collocations: include a link in your email signature

words.enDefinition: a document included with a physical letter, often listed under the signature

examples.en: The reference form was marked as an enclosure at the bottom of my letter.
examples.zh: 我在信的底部把推荐表标注为「随信附上的材料」。

examples.en: I forgot to include the enclosure when I first prepared the envelope.
examples.zh: 我第一次装信封时，忘了放进「随信附上的材料」。

words.enDefinition: a formal phrase introducing the document attached to an email or letter

examples.en: Please find attached my cover letter and two writing samples for the internship.
examples.zh: 「随信附上」申请该实习的求职信和两篇写作样本，请查收。

examples.en: The sample email opens with “Please find attached” before giving the file name.
examples.zh: 邮件样例以「随信附上」开头，然后写出文件名。

collocations: please find attached my cover letter
please find attached the requested documents
please find attached a copy of my portfolio

words.enDefinition: a written statement showing how an applicant meets the requirements of a role or opportunity

examples.en: The university asked for a supporting statement outlining how I met the selection criteria.
examples.zh: 学校要求我提供一份「岗位胜任陈述」，阐明我怎样满足筛选条件。

examples.en: I used my supporting statement to explain the responsibilities I had during my placement.
examples.zh: 我在「岗位胜任陈述」里解释了自己实习期间承担的职责。

collocations: a supporting statement against the selection criteria

words.enDefinition: to show in an application how one's evidence meets the published requirements

examples.en: The guide explains how to address the selection criteria for a university position.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了申请大学的岗位时怎样「逐项回应筛选条件」。

examples.en: I added examples from my lab placement to address the selection criteria more directly.
examples.zh: 为了更直接地「逐项回应筛选条件」，我加上了实验室实习的例子。

collocations: address the selection criteria in writing
use examples to address the selection criteria

words.enDefinition: to adapt a cover letter to a particular job or employer

examples.en: I learned to tailor a cover letter by using details from the actual posting.
examples.zh: 我学会了利用招聘启事里的具体信息「按岗位调整求职信」。

examples.en: The adviser showed us how to tailor a cover letter without changing the facts.
examples.zh: 顾问教我们怎样在不改动事实的情况下「按岗位调整求职信」。

collocations: tailor a cover letter to the role
tailor a cover letter to each employer
tailor a cover letter for an internship

words.zhGloss: 提到推荐人或推荐来源
words.enDefinition: to say in an application that someone referred you to an employer or vacancy
acceptedZhAnswers: 提到推荐人或推荐来源

examples.en: I asked the adviser whether I could mention a referral in my first paragraph.
examples.zh: 我问顾问能不能在第一段「提到推荐人或推荐来源」。

examples.en: The form showed me where to mention a referral from a current employee.
examples.zh: 表格标出了我可以在哪里「提到推荐人或推荐来源」，也就是给我推荐岗位的在职员工。

collocations: mention a referral in your letter
decide whether to mention a referral

words.enDefinition: to state or refer to the specific title of the job in application materials

examples.en: My adviser asked me to reference the job title in the first sentence.
examples.zh: 顾问要我在第一句「写明岗位名称」。

examples.en: I made sure to reference the job title in both the email and the attachment.
examples.zh: 我在邮件和附件里都确认「写明了岗位名称」。

collocations: reference the job title in the opening
reference the job title in the subject line

words.enDefinition: to communicate that you want to learn about or be considered for an opportunity

examples.en: You can express your interest in the placement by explaining what you hope to learn.
examples.zh: 你可以说明自己想学到什么，借此「表达你对这项实习的兴趣」。

examples.en: You can express your interest in the archive role by mentioning your cataloguing experience.
examples.zh: 你可以提及目录编制经验，借此「表达对档案岗位的兴趣」。

collocations: express your interest in the role

words.enDefinition: a phrase introducing the reason a role or organization is appealing to the writer

examples.en: What draws me to this role is the chance to help digitize local archives.
examples.zh: 「吸引我选择这个岗位的地方」是能参与本地档案的数字化。

examples.en: What draws me to this placement is the chance to work with community groups.
examples.zh: 「吸引我选择这项实习的地方」是能有机会与社区团体合作。

collocations: what draws me to this role
what draws me to your organization
explain what draws me to the position

words.enDefinition: to describe why someone is moving from one kind of work to another

examples.en: I used one sentence to explain a career change from hospitality to museum work.
examples.zh: 我用一句话「解释了转行的原因」，说明为什么从餐旅服务转到博物馆工作。

examples.en: The adviser showed how to explain a career change without dismissing earlier experience.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了怎样「解释转行的原因」，而不低估之前的经历。

collocations: explain a career change in your letter
be ready to explain a career change

words.enDefinition: to provide facts or examples showing why a statement should be believed

examples.en: I used visitor survey results to back up a claim about improving our information desk.
examples.zh: 我用来访者的调查结果「支持了我的主张」，即信息台的服务有所改进。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to back up a claim about organizing a large student event.
examples.zh: 顾问要我「用证据支持主张」，说明我确实组织过一场大型学生活动。

collocations: back up a claim with evidence
back up a claim with figures
use an example to back up a claim

words.enDefinition: to describe a particular instance that demonstrates a general point

examples.en: I tried to give a concrete example rather than list all my software skills.
examples.zh: 我试着「举了个具体的例子」，没有只罗列自己掌握的软件技能。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to give a concrete example of working under pressure.
examples.zh: 导师要我就如何在压力下工作「举个具体的例子」。

collocations: give a concrete example from your work
give a concrete example of a skill
ask someone to give a concrete example

words.enDefinition: to use what you have learned or done in the past to handle something now

examples.en: You can draw on your experience in group projects when writing about teamwork.
examples.zh: 写团队合作时，可以「借鉴你在小组项目中的经验」。

examples.en: The adviser said to draw on your experience outside paid work for the application.
examples.zh: 顾问说，写申请时也可以「用上你在有偿工作之外积累的经验」。

collocations: draw on your experience of teamwork
draw on your experience in class
draw on your experience outside work

words.enDefinition: to draw attention to a project that demonstrates a skill needed for the role

examples.en: I used the second paragraph to highlight a relevant project from my design course.
examples.zh: 我在第二段「突出了一个相关项目」，也就是设计课上的一个项目。

examples.en: The form asked me to highlight a relevant project and explain what I contributed.
examples.zh: 表格让我「突出一个相关项目」，并说明自己做了什么。

collocations: highlight a relevant project in the letter
highlight a relevant project from class
use your portfolio to highlight a relevant project

words.enDefinition: to demonstrate that skills learned in one setting can be used in another

examples.en: The adviser asked me to show transferable skills from my café job in the letter.
examples.zh: 顾问要我在信里「展示可迁移的技能」，也就是在咖啡馆工作时学到的本领。

examples.en: I used my volunteer work to show transferable skills that matched the museum role.
examples.zh: 我用志愿经历「展示了与博物馆岗位相符的可迁移技能」。

collocations: use examples to show transferable skills
show transferable skills in an application

words.zhGloss: 把技能用到实际工作中
words.enDefinition: to use abilities one has learned to do something real
acceptedZhAnswers: 把技能用到实际工作中

examples.en: The position would let me put skills into practice outside my usual classroom exercises.
examples.zh: 这个岗位能让我在课堂练习之外「把技能用到实际工作中」。

examples.en: I wanted to put skills into practice while helping the team prepare its exhibition.
examples.zh: 我想一边帮团队准备展览，一边「把技能用到实际工作中」。

collocations: put skills into practice at work
an opportunity to put skills into practice
put skills into practice on a project

words.enDefinition: to help a group accomplish its work or achieve a shared goal

examples.en: I explained how my tutoring experience would let me contribute to the team.
examples.zh: 我说明了自己怎样用辅导经验「为团队出力」。

examples.en: The letter shows how I would contribute to the team during busy weeks.
examples.zh: 信里说明了我会怎样在忙的时候「为团队出力」。

collocations: contribute to the team from day one
be ready to contribute to the team
look for ways to contribute to the team

words.enDefinition: to find out additional information about a job and what it involves

examples.en: I said I would welcome the chance to learn more about the role.
examples.zh: 我说我希望有机会「进一步了解岗位」。

examples.en: I attended the session to learn more about the role before writing my application.
examples.zh: 写申请之前，我参加说明会「进一步了解岗位」。

collocations: an opportunity to learn more about the role
ask questions to learn more about the role
get in touch to learn more about the role

words.enDefinition: to review my application and decide whether it should progress

examples.en: I thanked the hiring team for taking the time to consider my application.
examples.zh: 我感谢招聘团队抽出时间「考虑我的申请」。

examples.en: I asked whether they could still consider my application for the autumn intake.
examples.zh: 我问对方是否还能为秋季招聘批次「考虑我的申请」。

collocations: take time to consider my application

words.enDefinition: a polite closing thanking the reader for considering a request or application

examples.en: Thank you for your consideration of my application for the library assistant position.
examples.zh: 「感谢您审阅我的申请」，我想申请的是图书馆助理岗位。

examples.en: The sample uses “Thank you for your consideration” as its final full sentence.
examples.zh: 样本的最后一句完整的话是「感谢您审阅我的申请」。

collocations: close with thank you for your consideration
write thank you for your consideration
end the email with thank you for your consideration

words.expression: look forward to hearing from you
words.lemma: look forward to hearing from you
words.enDefinition: to express politely that one hopes to receive a response
acceptedEnVariants: look forward to hearing from you

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you about the next steps in the process.
examples.zh: 我「期待您的回复」，也想了解接下来有哪些步骤。

examples.en: The tutor said “I look forward to hearing from you” was a suitable closing here.
examples.zh: 导师说，这里可以用「期待您的回复」结尾。

collocations: I look forward to hearing from you soon
close with look forward to hearing from you
look forward to hearing from you about the role

words.enDefinition: able to attend an interview at the requested or offered time

examples.en: I mentioned that I was available for an interview on most weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 我提到，大多数工作日上午我都「可以参加面试」。

examples.en: The recruiter asked if I would be available for an interview during reading week.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问我在阅读周期间是否「可以参加面试」。

collocations: available for an interview next week
confirm you are available for an interview

words.enDefinition: a respectful and appropriate manner of communicating in a work-related setting

examples.en: The adviser helped me keep a professional tone without making the letter sound stiff.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我保留了「专业得体的语气」，同时没让信读起来太生硬。

examples.en: I used a more professional tone when I revised the email to the recruiter.
examples.zh: 我修改发给招聘人员的邮件时，用了更「专业得体的语气」。

words.enDefinition: easy to understand and expressed without unnecessary words

examples.en: The reviewer said my opening was clear and concise after I cut the background details.
examples.zh: 我删去背景细节后，审阅人说我的开头「清楚简洁」。

examples.en: I tried to keep the project summary clear and concise for the hiring team.
examples.zh: 我尽量把给招聘团队看的项目摘要写得「清楚简洁」。

collocations: keep the wording clear and concise
make your answers clear and concise

words.enDefinition: to check written material carefully for mistakes before sending or publishing it

examples.en: I printed the letter so I could proofread for errors away from my screen.
examples.zh: 我把信打印出来，好离开屏幕做一次「校读查错」。

examples.en: My friend offered to proofread for errors before I sent the final file.
examples.zh: 发出最终文件前，朋友主动帮我「校读查错」。

collocations: ask someone to proofread for errors

words.enDefinition: to take out words or phrases that add no useful information

examples.en: The tutor asked me to remove filler from the first two sentences.
examples.zh: 导师让我把前两句里的「赘词删去」。

examples.en: I needed to remove filler so the project example stood out more clearly.
examples.zh: 我得「删去赘词」，让项目例子更醒目。

collocations: revise a paragraph to remove filler

words.enDefinition: how smoothly words and ideas move within or between sentences

examples.en: Reading the letter aloud helped me hear where the sentence flow became awkward.
examples.zh: 把信读出来后，我听出了哪里「句子衔接」不顺。

examples.en: The tutor suggested moving one phrase to improve the sentence flow in that paragraph.
examples.zh: 导师建议挪动一个短语，改善那段的「句子衔接」。

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check when preparing an initial written version

examples.en: I used a drafting checklist to make sure the letter named the correct employer.
examples.zh: 我用「起草检查清单」确认信里写的是正确的雇主。

examples.en: The workshop's drafting checklist includes a reminder to give one concrete example.
examples.zh: 讲座提供的「起草检查清单」提醒写信人给出一个具体例子。

words.enDefinition: an example of what someone has produced, used to demonstrate their skills

examples.en: The recruiter asked for a work sample that showed how I presented research findings.
examples.zh: 招聘人员想看一份能展示我怎样汇报研究结果的「工作成果样本」。

examples.en: I chose a work sample from a project I had finished last term.
examples.zh: 我从上学期完成的一个项目里选了一份「工作成果样本」。

words.enDefinition: a short part taken from a longer document or work sample

examples.en: I sent a sample excerpt because the full report ran to forty pages.
examples.zh: 完整报告有四十页，所以我只发了一段「样本节选」。

examples.en: My sample excerpt starts with the section where I explain the research method.
examples.zh: 我的「样本节选」从我说明研究方法的那一节开始。

collocations: a sample excerpt from a report

words.enDefinition: an example of work that has already been made public through publication

examples.en: I chose a published sample from my time working on the student newspaper.
examples.zh: 我选了一份在学生报工作期间写的「已发表的样本」。

examples.en: The editor asked whether I could link to the published sample in my application.
examples.zh: 编辑问我能否在申请材料里添加「已发表的样本」的链接。

collocations: a published sample of your writing

words.enDefinition: an example of work that has not been published

examples.en: The application accepted an unpublished sample as long as I explained its context.
examples.zh: 申请方接受「未发表的样本」，但需要我说明作品背景。

examples.en: I selected an unpublished sample that I had written specifically for my course.
examples.zh: 我选了一个专门为课程写的「未发表的样本」。

collocations: an unpublished sample of your work

words.zhGloss: 隐去敏感信息的作品样本
words.enDefinition: an example of past work with confidential or identifying details removed or covered
acceptedZhAnswers: 隐去敏感信息的作品样本

examples.en: My supervisor approved a redacted work sample from the report I wrote last spring.
examples.zh: 主管批准我用去年春天写的报告提供一份「隐去敏感信息的作品样本」。

examples.en: The employer said a redacted work sample would be suitable for the first review.
examples.zh: 雇主说，可以用「隐去敏感信息的作品样本」参加初审。

collocations: a redacted work sample from a report

words.enDefinition: an example of work with notes explaining its features or the author's contribution

examples.en: I added arrows to the diagrams to create an annotated work sample for reviewers.
examples.zh: 我给图加了箭头，做成一份「带注释的作品样本」供评审阅读。

examples.en: The annotated work sample shows which images I created and which came from teammates.
examples.zh: 「带注释的作品样本」标出了哪些图片是我做的、哪些来自队友。

collocations: an annotated work sample with context

words.enDefinition: an example showing a person's work in editing or preparing content for publication

examples.en: The student newspaper asked for an editorial sample alongside a short cover letter.
examples.zh: 学生报要求附上一份「编辑作品样本」和一封简短求职信。

examples.en: My editorial sample showed how I shortened a feature while preserving its main argument.
examples.zh: 我的「编辑作品样本」展示了我怎样缩短一篇专题稿并保留它的主要论点。

collocations: an editorial sample from your portfolio

words.enDefinition: an example showing the corrections someone makes when checking written material

examples.en: I included a proofreading sample with visible corrections from a short newsletter draft.
examples.zh: 我附上了一份来自简讯初稿的「校对样本」，修改痕迹清晰可见。

examples.en: The editor asked whether the proofreading sample was from work I had completed independently.
examples.zh: 编辑问「校对样本」是不是我独立完成的。

words.enDefinition: an example showing how someone explains a technical topic or process in writing

examples.en: The lab asked for a technical writing sample that explained a method clearly.
examples.zh: 实验室要求提供一份能把方法讲清楚的「技术写作样本」。

examples.en: I chose a technical writing sample from an instruction sheet I had prepared.
examples.zh: 我从以前做过的说明单中选了一份「技术写作样本」。

words.enDefinition: a short explanation using accessible words and phrasing for readers without specialist knowledge

examples.en: My portfolio starts with a plain-language summary of the research question and the findings.
examples.zh: 我的作品集先用一份「通俗摘要」介绍研究问题和结果。

examples.en: I wrote a plain-language summary so applicants from outside the lab could follow it.
examples.zh: 我写了份「通俗摘要」，让实验室以外的申请人也能看懂。

words.enDefinition: a collection of design projects presented to show a person's skills and approach

examples.en: My design portfolio includes a campus map and a poster for the film club.
examples.zh: 我的「设计作品集」里有一张校园地图和一张电影社团海报。

examples.en: The studio asked me to share a design portfolio before the initial conversation.
examples.zh: 工作室让我在初次沟通前发送一份「设计作品集」。

words.enDefinition: a physical collection of printed work samples, often used for an in-person review

examples.en: I took a print portfolio to show the recruiter during the campus fair.
examples.zh: 我带了「纸质作品集」，在校园招聘会上给招聘人员看。

examples.en: The print portfolio includes full-page images so readers can see the poster details.
examples.zh: 「纸质作品集」里有整页图片，读者能看清海报细节。

words.enDefinition: a collection of work samples that people can view on the internet

examples.en: I updated my online portfolio with the signage project from my final semester.
examples.zh: 我把最后一学期做的导视项目补进了「在线作品集」。

examples.en: The recruiter opened my online portfolio while we talked about my photography work.
examples.zh: 我们聊到摄影作品时，招聘人员打开了我的「在线作品集」。

words.enDefinition: a web address that leads to a collection of someone's work

examples.en: I tested the portfolio link on my phone before sending the application.
examples.zh: 发出申请前，我先用手机测试了「作品集链接」。

examples.en: The portfolio link in my email opens directly to the project I mentioned.
examples.zh: 邮件里的「作品集链接」会直接打开我提到的那个项目。

words.enDefinition: one piece of work chosen for inclusion in a portfolio

examples.en: I chose a portfolio piece from my first year to show how I improved.
examples.zh: 我选了一件大一作品「放进作品集」，展示自己后来有哪些进步。

examples.en: The recruiter asked which portfolio piece I had developed with classmates last spring.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问，「作品集中的哪一件作品」是我去年春天与同学一起完成的。

words.enDefinition: a short video combining excerpts from someone's work to demonstrate their skills

examples.en: My showreel starts with three clips from the campus television project last spring.
examples.zh: 我的「作品展示短片」开头是去年春天校园电视项目的三个片段。

examples.en: The studio asked for a showreel that showed my editing and motion graphics work.
examples.zh: 工作室想看一段能展示剪辑和动态图形作品的「作品展示短片」。

words.enDefinition: a guided presentation explaining selected pieces of work and how they were developed

examples.en: The tutor invited me to rehearse my portfolio walkthrough with students from another course.
examples.zh: 导师请我和另一门课的同学一起排练「作品集讲解」。

examples.en: I started the portfolio walkthrough with the project that best showed my design process.
examples.zh: 我先讲最能展示设计过程的项目，作为「作品集讲解」的开场。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of selected work, often with feedback or a decision about a candidate

examples.en: The invitation said the portfolio review would take place before the final interview.
examples.zh: 邀请函说「作品集评审」会在最后一轮面试之前举行。

examples.en: I brought two printed samples to the portfolio review at the design school.
examples.zh: 我带了两份打印样本去设计学院参加「作品集评审」。

words.zhGloss: 展示短片镜头分工说明
words.enDefinition: a list explaining the creator's contribution to individual shots or segments in a showreel
acceptedZhAnswers: 展示短片镜头分工说明

examples.en: My reel breakdown identifies the scenes I animated while working with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我的「展示短片镜头分工说明」标出了我和两名同学合作时负责制作动画的场景。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for a reel breakdown covering the clips in my submission.
examples.zh: 评审请我为提交的视频片段提供一份「展示短片镜头分工说明」。

words.enDefinition: an organized collection of records or files from completed projects

examples.en: I moved the old posters to a project archive after redesigning the portfolio.
examples.zh: 重新设计作品集后，我把旧海报移进了「项目归档」。

examples.en: The project archive includes original sketches that are no longer on public display.
examples.zh: 「项目归档」里还有一些已经停止公开展示的原始素描。

collocations: save files to a project archive

words.enDefinition: a project given a prominent place in a presentation or collection of work

examples.en: My featured project is a campus wayfinding system developed with the disability team.
examples.zh: 我「重点展示的项目」是和残障支持团队一起开发的校园导视系统。

examples.en: The reviewer opened the featured project first because it matched the agency's work.
examples.zh: 评审先打开了「重点展示的项目」，因为它与机构的业务相符。

collocations: a featured project on the homepage

words.enDefinition: an entry that explains a project's context, process, contribution and results in a portfolio

examples.en: The portfolio case study explains how I tested two layouts with student volunteers.
examples.zh: 这份「作品集项目案例」说明了我怎样和学生志愿者一起测试两种布局。

examples.en: I added a portfolio case study about a group project from my final term.
examples.zh: 我加了一篇「作品集项目案例」，讲的是最后一个学期的小组项目。

words.enDefinition: a brief description of what a project involves and why it was done

examples.en: The project overview gives the reader enough context to understand the images below.
examples.zh: 「项目概述」提供了足够的背景，帮助读者理解下面的图片。

examples.en: I moved the client description into the project overview when I revised the page.
examples.zh: 修改页面时，我把客户介绍移到了「项目概述」里。

words.enDefinition: a document that states what a project should accomplish and what conditions it must meet

examples.en: The project brief asked us to design signs for visitors unfamiliar with the building.
examples.zh: 「项目任务说明」要求我们为不熟悉这栋楼的访客设计标识。

examples.en: I compared the completed posters with the original project brief before writing the case study.
examples.zh: 写案例前，我把完工的海报和最初的「项目任务说明」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: factors such as time, cost or materials that limit what a project can do

examples.en: The project constraints included a limited printing budget and an early installation deadline.
examples.zh: 「项目限制条件」包括印刷预算有限和安装截止日较早。

examples.en: I described the project constraints so readers understood why we chose recycled materials.
examples.zh: 我说明了「项目限制条件」，让读者理解我们为什么选择再生材料。

words.enDefinition: the circumstances around a project that help explain its purpose or decisions

examples.en: I added a short description of the project context before showing the final design.
examples.zh: 我先简要介绍了「项目背景」，再展示最终设计。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for more project context about who would use the service.
examples.zh: 评审想了解更多「项目背景」，尤其是谁会使用这项服务。

words.enDefinition: the reasoning behind the decisions made in a design

examples.en: I explained the design rationale with notes about how visitors read the signs.
examples.zh: 我用访客阅读标识的观察笔记来说明「设计决策依据」。

examples.en: The design rationale links each color choice to a requirement in the original brief.
examples.zh: 「设计决策依据」把每种颜色的选择与原任务说明里的一项要求联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the activities and stages through which a design is planned, tested and developed

examples.en: The portfolio shows the design process from early sketches to the finished map.
examples.zh: 作品集展示了从早期草图到最终地图的「设计过程」。

examples.en: I wrote a brief caption for each stage of the design process.
examples.zh: 我给「设计过程」的每个阶段写了一段简短说明。

collocations: a step in the design process

words.enDefinition: a revised version or cycle of changes made to improve a design

examples.en: Each design iteration changed the size or contrast of the directions on the sign.
examples.zh: 每「一次设计迭代」都调整了标识上指示信息的大小或对比度。

examples.en: I chose one design iteration to show how feedback had changed the layout.
examples.zh: 我选了「一次设计迭代」，用来展示反馈怎样改变了布局。

words.enDefinition: an initial working model made to test an idea before final development

examples.en: The early prototype used cardboard so our team could test the shape cheaply.
examples.zh: 「早期原型」是纸板做的，让团队能低成本测试形状。

examples.en: I included the early prototype to show why the final version had fewer parts.
examples.zh: 我放进了「早期原型」，让读者看出最终版本为什么减少了部件。

words.enDefinition: the finished item a project must hand over to a client or other recipient

examples.en: The final deliverable was a set of maps that the school could print immediately.
examples.zh: 「最终交付成果」是一套学校可以立即印刷的地图。

examples.en: I put the final deliverable at the end so readers could see what changed.
examples.zh: 我把「最终交付成果」放在结尾，方便读者看出前后变化。

words.enDefinition: a presentation showing the condition of something before and after a change

examples.en: The before-and-after comparison made the improvement in the poster layout easier to see.
examples.zh: 「改动前后对比」让海报布局的改进更容易看出来。

examples.en: I used a before-and-after comparison to show what changed on the sign.
examples.zh: 我用「改动前后对比」展示标识上都改了哪里。

words.enDefinition: a clear description of a problem a project is meant to address

examples.en: The problem statement explains why visitors struggled to find the entrances after dark.
examples.zh: 「问题说明」解释了为什么访客在天黑后很难找到入口。

examples.en: I rewrote the problem statement after our interviews revealed a different main concern.
examples.zh: 访谈发现大家主要担心的是另一个问题，我于是重写了「问题说明」。

words.enDefinition: a choice that improves one aspect of a design at the cost of another

examples.en: The case study explains a design trade-off between larger text and fewer directions.
examples.zh: 案例解释了一项「设计上的权衡」，也就是在加大文字和减少指示信息之间取舍。

examples.en: I used two versions of the map to illustrate the design trade-off for reviewers.
examples.zh: 我用两个版本的地图向评审说明这项「设计上的权衡」。

collocations: a design trade-off between clarity and detail

words.enDefinition: an account of what someone learned from a project and what they would change

examples.en: My project reflection explains why I would test the route earlier next time.
examples.zh: 我在「项目反思」里说明了为什么下次会更早测试路线。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to focus my project reflection on one decision that mattered.
examples.zh: 导师让我围绕一个重要决定来写「项目反思」。

words.enDefinition: a list identifying people or organizations that contributed to a project

examples.en: I put the project credits under the photographs so the photographer was acknowledged.
examples.zh: 我把「项目人员署名」放在照片下方，写明了摄影者。

examples.en: The project credits name the classmates who helped write and edit the script.
examples.zh: 「项目人员署名」列出了帮忙编写和编辑脚本的同学。

collocations: be listed in the project credits

words.enDefinition: an account of what each person was responsible for in shared work

examples.en: The role breakdown lets readers tell which parts I designed and which my partner wrote.
examples.zh: 「各成员的分工说明」让读者看出哪些部分是我设计的，哪些是搭档写的。

examples.en: I added a role breakdown because the project involved people from three courses.
examples.zh: 这个项目有三门课的同学参加，我加了一份「各成员的分工说明」。

collocations: a role breakdown for the team

words.enDefinition: work completed for a real client who has requested or commissioned it

examples.en: I asked the studio before adding any client work to my public portfolio.
examples.zh: 在公开作品集里放「为客户做的项目」之前，我先问了工作室。

examples.en: The portfolio separates client work from the projects I completed for class.
examples.zh: 作品集把「为客户做的项目」与课程项目分开列出了。

words.enDefinition: a project that someone undertakes without pay to support an organization or community

examples.en: I used a volunteer project from the food bank to demonstrate my scheduling skills.
examples.zh: 我用食物银行的一个「志愿服务项目」展示自己的排班能力。

examples.en: The volunteer project gave me experience working with people from several different courses.
examples.zh: 「志愿服务项目」给了我和不同课程的同学一起工作的经验。

words.enDefinition: a project someone does for their own goals or interests independently of assigned work

examples.en: The first page features a personal project I completed during the summer break.
examples.zh: 第一页重点展示了我暑假完成的一个「个人项目」。

examples.en: I chose a personal project to show work outside my university course requirements.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「个人项目」，展示大学课程要求之外的作品。

words.enDefinition: a piece of project work completed as part of a class

examples.en: I included a course project that involved producing a booklet for new students.
examples.zh: 我收录了一个「课程项目」，内容是为新生制作一本小册子。

examples.en: The recruiter asked how the course project had been assessed by the lecturer.
examples.zh: 招聘人员询问授课老师是怎样给这个「课程项目」评分的。

words.enDefinition: professional work provided free of charge, often for a public or charitable purpose

examples.en: The studio included some pro bono work for a local charity in its portfolio.
examples.zh: 工作室在作品集中收录了为本地慈善机构提供的「无偿专业服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether the theatre poster counted as pro bono work for my application.
examples.zh: 我问在申请材料里，剧院海报能不能算作「无偿专业服务」。

collocations: pro bono work for a nonprofit

words.enDefinition: an invented project brief used for practice or to show how someone would approach a problem

examples.en: I used a mock brief from the course to design a poster series.
examples.zh: 我根据课程里的「模拟项目任务书」设计了一组海报。

examples.en: The reviewer knew the client was fictional because I labelled it a mock brief.
examples.zh: 我注明这是「模拟项目任务书」，评审就知道客户是虚构的。

collocations: a mock brief for a design task

words.enDefinition: work that is not yet available to the public or its intended audience

examples.en: I left the unreleased work out of my portfolio until the studio approved it.
examples.zh: 工作室批准之前，我没有把「尚未公开的作品」放进作品集。

examples.en: The recruiter said they did not need to see any unreleased work from clients.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，他们不需要看客户的任何「尚未公开的作品」。

words.enDefinition: work intended to be viewed or used by people outside the organization

examples.en: The sample is public-facing work created for visitors to the campus museum.
examples.zh: 这个样本是为校园博物馆访客制作的「面向公众的作品」。

examples.en: I separated public-facing work from documents that only the committee had seen.
examples.zh: 我把「面向公众的作品」和只有委员会看过的文档分开。

words.enDefinition: information or work that is not subject to confidentiality restrictions

examples.en: The studio told me which nonconfidential material I could include in my portfolio.
examples.zh: 工作室告诉我，哪些「非保密材料」可以放进我的作品集。

examples.en: I used nonconfidential material to explain my role without sharing the client's records.
examples.zh: 我用「非保密材料」说明自己做了什么，没有公开客户的记录。

words.enDefinition: an example of work containing information that may be shared only with authorization

examples.en: I asked my supervisor before showing a confidential work sample to the recruiter.
examples.zh: 把「保密作品样本」给招聘人员看之前，我先问了主管。

examples.en: The employer offered to accept a different example instead of the confidential work sample.
examples.zh: 雇主表示可以收另一份样本，用来替代这份「保密作品样本」。

collocations: permission to share a confidential work sample

words.enDefinition: authorization to give specified information or work to other people

examples.en: I obtained permission to share the illustrations before putting them on my website.
examples.zh: 把插图放上网站前，我取得了「分享许可」。

examples.en: The producer gave me permission to share only the original trailer from the project.
examples.zh: 制片人给了我「分享许可」，范围仅限该项目的原版预告片。

collocations: get permission to share the work

words.enDefinition: a collection of work that viewers can open only with the correct password

examples.en: I sent a password-protected portfolio because one page was approved only for private review.
examples.zh: 由于有一页只批准私下审阅，我发送了「密码保护的作品集」。

examples.en: The recruiter asked how long the password-protected portfolio would stay available to them.
examples.zh: 招聘人员问，他们能访问这份「密码保护的作品集」多久。

collocations: a link to a password-protected portfolio

words.enDefinition: a video omitted from public listings which users can typically view using its link

examples.en: The application accepted an unlisted video as long as the link worked for reviewers.
examples.zh: 申请方接受「不公开列出的视频」，只要评审能通过链接打开。

examples.en: I sent the panel a link to an unlisted video showing my design process.
examples.zh: 我给评审组发了一个「不公开列出的视频」链接，视频展示了我的设计过程。

words.enDefinition: a link granting permission to view a file or page without allowing edits

examples.en: I sent a view-only link so the employer could open the slides without changing them.
examples.zh: 我发了「仅供查看的链接」，雇主能打开幻灯片，但不能修改。

examples.en: The adviser tested the view-only link from a browser without my account signed in.
examples.zh: 顾问在没有登录我的账号的浏览器里测试了「仅供查看的链接」。

words.enDefinition: the point at which permission to open an online file or resource ends

examples.en: I checked the access expiration date before sharing the project with the panel.
examples.zh: 把项目分享给评审组前，我查看了「访问权限到期日」。

examples.en: The team asked me to move the access expiration date beyond the final interview.
examples.zh: 团队请我把「访问权限到期日」延到最后一轮面试之后。

words.enDefinition: a preview image or video with fewer pixels than the original

examples.en: The low-resolution preview loads quickly, but the print layout shows the image details.
examples.zh: 「低分辨率预览」加载很快，印刷布局里能看到图像的细节。

examples.en: I attached a low-resolution preview because the full image was too large to email.
examples.zh: 完整图片太大，邮件发不过去，所以我附了一张「低分辨率预览」。

words.enDefinition: short text accompanying an image to identify it or explain its relevance

examples.en: The image caption identifies the campus building and the purpose of the new sign.
examples.zh: 「图片说明文字」写明了是哪栋校园建筑，以及新标识的用途。

examples.en: I changed the image caption to note that the photo was taken on opening day.
examples.zh: 我修改了「图片说明文字」，补充说明照片是在开幕那天拍的。

words.enDefinition: a record naming the creators or sources of images used in a publication or display

examples.en: I added image credits for the photographs taken by my classmates at the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我为同学在展览上拍的照片加了「图片来源署名」。

examples.en: The reviewer checked whether all the photographs had corresponding image credits on the page.
examples.zh: 评审核对了每张照片在页面上有没有相应的「图片来源署名」。

words.enDefinition: a web component that lets viewers move through a series of images in one space

examples.en: The image carousel shows each poster before visitors reach the longer case study.
examples.zh: 访客读到较长的案例之前，可以先在「图片轮播」里看每张海报。

examples.en: I tested whether the image carousel worked when viewed on a narrow screen.
examples.zh: 我测试了「图片轮播」在窄屏上能不能正常使用。

collocations: an image carousel on the project page

words.enDefinition: a small image preview representing a larger picture, video or page

examples.en: The thumbnail showed the final poster before visitors clicked through to the project.
examples.zh: 访客点进项目之前，「缩略图」上显示的是最终的海报。

examples.en: I replaced the thumbnail with a clearer crop of the same design.
examples.zh: 我用同一设计中裁得更清楚的图替换了「缩略图」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of work provided as a file that viewers can save locally

examples.en: The downloadable portfolio was smaller than the version I used for in-person reviews.
examples.zh: 「可下载的作品集」文件比我带去现场评审的版本小。

examples.en: I tested the downloadable portfolio on a tablet before sharing it with the studio.
examples.zh: 把「可下载的作品集」发给工作室之前，我先用平板测试了一下。

collocations: a link to a downloadable portfolio

words.enDefinition: a collection of work samples saved as a PDF document

examples.en: My PDF portfolio contains four pages of project images and a short biography.
examples.zh: 我的「PDF格式作品集」包含四页项目图片和一段个人简介。

examples.en: The agency asked me to send a PDF portfolio instead of printing the pages.
examples.zh: 机构让我发一份「PDF格式作品集」，不用把页面打印出来。

words.enDefinition: a place where project files and their change history are openly available

examples.en: I linked to the public repository where the group had published our code.
examples.zh: 我添加了「公开代码仓库」的链接，那里面有小组发布的代码。

examples.en: The public repository contained the project files and a short description of my contribution.
examples.zh: 「公开代码仓库」里有项目文件，以及一段介绍我做了什么的文字。

collocations: publish code in a public repository

words.enDefinition: a demonstration that shows a product, process or project working in real time

examples.en: I prepared a live demo so the panel could see the map respond immediately.
examples.zh: 我准备了「现场演示」，让评审组看到地图即时响应的效果。

examples.en: The screen froze halfway through the live demo, so I showed a recording.
examples.zh: 「现场演示」到一半时画面卡住了，我就改放录像。

words.enDefinition: a web address giving access to a working demonstration or a recording of it

examples.en: My demo link opened a running version of the project without a sign-in screen.
examples.zh: 我的「演示链接」打开的是项目的运行版本，无须登录。

examples.en: The panel asked for a demo link so they could review the project later.
examples.zh: 评审组让我发一个「演示链接」，方便他们稍后看项目。

words.enDefinition: text describing an image's content or purpose when it cannot be seen

examples.en: I added alt text to explain what each chart showed in the portfolio.
examples.zh: 我添加了「替代文字」，说明作品集里的每张图表展示了什么。

examples.en: The reviewer checked whether the alt text made sense without seeing the photographs.
examples.zh: 评审核实了在看不到照片的情况下，「替代文字」能不能讲清楚。

words.enDefinition: written or visual records showing the steps by which a project was completed

examples.en: My process documentation includes notes from the first meeting and pictures of the prototype.
examples.zh: 我的「过程记录」包括第一次会议的笔记和原型的照片。

examples.en: The portfolio links to process documentation for readers who want to see earlier versions.
examples.zh: 作品集里放了「过程记录」的链接，想了解早期版本的读者可以点开。

words.enDefinition: a short video explaining what something is or how it works

examples.en: I recorded an explainer video so visitors could see how the prototype worked.
examples.zh: 我录了一段「讲解视频」，让访客了解原型是怎样运作的。

examples.en: The explainer video uses captions for viewers who watch it without sound.
examples.zh: 「讲解视频」配有字幕，方便关掉声音观看的人。

words.zhGloss: 隐去可能暴露身份的信息
words.enDefinition: to remove or cover information that could allow someone to identify a person or organization
acceptedZhAnswers: 隐去可能暴露身份的信息

examples.en: My supervisor asked me to redact identifying details before saving a shareable work sample.
examples.zh: 主管让我先「隐去可能暴露身份的信息」，再保存可以分享的作品样本。

examples.en: I learned to redact identifying details when preparing interview notes for the portfolio.
examples.zh: 整理要放进作品集的采访笔记时，我学会了怎样「隐去可能暴露身份的信息」。

collocations: redact identifying details from a document
ask someone to redact identifying details

words.enDefinition: to alter a sample so that its people or sources cannot reasonably be identified

examples.en: I asked how to anonymize a sample from interviews conducted for the community project.
examples.zh: 我问如何「将样本匿名化」，这些样本来自社区项目中的访谈。

examples.en: We had to anonymize a sample before we could include it in the portfolio.
examples.zh: 我们必须先「将样本匿名化」，才能把它放进作品集。

words.enDefinition: to explain what responsibilities you held or what work you performed

examples.en: The portfolio form asks you to describe your role clearly for each group project.
examples.zh: 作品集表格要求对每个小组项目清楚「说明你负责的工作」。

examples.en: The adviser suggested that you describe your role before showing the finished product.
examples.zh: 顾问建议先「说明你负责的工作」，再展示最终成果。

collocations: describe your role in a team
describe your role in a project

words.enDefinition: to express a result in measurable numbers rather than only in words

examples.en: I used attendance records to quantify an outcome from the event I organized.
examples.zh: 我查阅了出勤记录，给我组织的活动「量化成果」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether I could quantify an outcome from the campus project.
examples.zh: 导师问我，能不能把校园项目的一项「成果用数字说明」。

words.enDefinition: instructions about how to submit a portfolio and what it should contain

examples.en: The portfolio submission guidelines allow either a website link or a PDF file.
examples.zh: 「作品集提交规范」允许提供网站链接或 PDF 文件。

examples.en: I read the portfolio submission guidelines before deciding which work samples to include.
examples.zh: 挑选要收录的作品样本前，我读了「作品集提交规范」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of detail an image can represent, often expressed using pixel dimensions

examples.en: I checked the image resolution before exporting the poster pages for the portfolio.
examples.zh: 导出作品集里的海报页面之前，我检查了「图像分辨率」。

examples.en: The reviewer asked for better image resolution so the tiny labels were legible.
examples.zh: 评审要求提高「图像分辨率」，让特别小的标签看得清。

words.enDefinition: to reduce the amount of storage space taken up by a PDF document

examples.en: I had to compress a PDF before the application portal would accept it.
examples.zh: 我得先「压缩PDF文件」，申请平台才会接收。

examples.en: I asked how to compress a PDF without making the portfolio images blurry.
examples.zh: 我问如何「压缩PDF文件」，同时让作品集图片保持清晰。

collocations: use a tool to compress a PDF

words.enDefinition: a PDF designed so that people using assistive technology can read and navigate it

examples.en: I exported an accessible PDF so the text could be read with a screen reader.
examples.zh: 我导出了「无障碍PDF文档」，这样屏幕阅读器就能读出文字。

examples.en: The guide asks applicants to submit an accessible PDF with a clear reading order.
examples.zh: 指南要求申请人提交阅读顺序清楚的「无障碍PDF文档」。
